verdict: Meta efficiency jumped sharply; overdue build items need to close now.
narrative: This period, your Meta campaigns delivered a meaningful efficiency win — 32 leads at $6.16 cost per lead, with lead volume nearly doubling week-over-week while spend actually fell 6%. That gain is real and confirmed. At the same time, nine build milestones from the agreed plan — covering tracking, search campaigns, CRM setup, and lead nurture — remain undelivered, the earliest now 49 days past due. These open items are the priority focus this week, and we're working through them in sequence to close the gap before the Phase 1 close date of September 30. Once tracking and pipeline intake are fully connected, you'll have a complete view of what happens to leads after they arrive.
